method: Flag rows gained runtime_read/runtime_bound facts and AST-resolved defaults; signals now state how the runtime uses a name. A decision current against the previous extractor's row is rebased unless its note says the flag is phantom, never read by hipengine/, or read only outside the runtime while the runtime reads it; those, and the branch findings on such flags, keep their decision-time basis and stay stale. Notes that say they correct an earlier phantom-name decision are not contradictions.
